import numpy as np
metal_fail = df['잔류금속 (wt%)'] > 5.0
ig_id_fail = df['IG/ID'] < 2.2
df['불합격사유'] = np.where(metal_fail & ig_id_fail, '둘 다', np.where(metal_fail, '잔류금속 > 5.0 wt%만', np.where(ig_id_fail, 'IG/ID < 2.2만', '기타')))
df = df[df['불합격사유'] != '기타']
